notes: Guidance safety rules (spec 01). Model output that names a medicine, gives a dose, or tells the Patient not to see a dentist is replaced with the safe fallback. Complaints that try to change the agent's rules get the fixed polite redirect without any model call.
Matching is case-insensitive on the text with accents removed. medicines and phrases match whole words; dosePatterns are regular expressions.
Add cases to services/agent/tests/test_guidance.py when you extend this file, and bump version.
discouragePhrases: tidak perlu periksa ke dokter gigi
no need to see a dentist
no need to visit a dentist
dont need to see a dentist
don't need to see a dentist
do not need to see a dentist

redirect.id: FindYourDent hanya membantu keluhan gigi dan mulut. Ceritakan keluhan gigi atau mulut Anda, misalnya gigi mana yang sakit dan sejak kapan.
redirect.en: FindYourDent only helps with tooth and mouth problems. Tell us about your tooth or mouth complaint, for example which tooth hurts and since when.

id.explanation: Keluhan Anda perlu diperiksa langsung oleh dokter gigi supaya penyebabnya jelas. Untuk obat dan dosisnya, tanyakan apoteker atau dokter gigi.
id.visit: Pemeriksaan oleh dokter gigi untuk mencari penyebab keluhan dan menentukan perawatannya.
whyPricesVary: Perawatan yang dibutuhkan baru bisa dipastikan setelah pemeriksaan.
Ditangani dokter gigi umum atau dokter gigi spesialis.

en.explanation: Your complaint needs a dentist to examine it so the cause is clear. For medicines and doses, ask a pharmacist or dentist.
en.visit: An examination by a dentist to find the cause and decide the treatment.
whyPricesVary: The treatment needed is only certain after an examination.
Whether a general dentist or a specialist treats it.

emergencyReason.id: Keluhan Anda menunjukkan tanda bahaya yang perlu ditangani di IGD sekarang.
emergencyReason.en: Your complaint shows warning signs that need an emergency department now.

disclaimer.id: Ini informasi edukasi, bukan diagnosis. Tetap periksakan gigi Anda ke dokter gigi. Untuk obat, tanyakan apoteker atau dokter gigi.
disclaimer.en: This is educational information, not a diagnosis. Please still see a dentist. For medicines, ask a pharmacist or dentist.
